Bldgs. 11 & 12 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002, by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer") and NYC Partnership Housing Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property in borough of Manhattan as describedonSchedule“A"Block1928Lot20&P/OLot120 andBlock1928Lot21& P/O Lot 120, New York, NY, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon which WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that each of the buildings shall adjoin the other and shall be connected to each other by a common Party Wall (*"Party Wall"); WHEREAS the Declarants desire to declare the following restrictions,covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS, thehome designated asBlock1928Lot20&P/OLot.120 is located at street address 231 West 122d Street, New York, N.Y. and the home on the other side of thePartyWall is designatedasBlock1928Lot21 &P/OLot 120 and is located at street address 227 West 123rd Street, New York, NY; NOW THEREFORE,the following declaration of restrictions,covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, successors and assigns and shall run with the land and be binding upon each successive ownerof Block1928Lot20&P/OLot120andofBlock1928Lot21&P/OLot120, New York, N.Y. and the heirs, successors and assigns of each such subsequent owner. 1. ThePartyWall was constructed in such a fashion as to be located an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. The Party Wall shall be used and maintained as a Party Wall forever and the owner of thelotoneachsideofthePartyWall,shallbelicensedandpermittedtoenter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make necessary repairs upon advance notification to said adjoining owner of such intentions to do so. Furthermore, a representative of the owner of the premises to be entered mustbe presentwhenever the owner or representatives of the owner on

Bldgs.11&12 the other side of the Party Wall enters such premises, pursuant to this Declaration of Restrictions. 3. On the owner's side, said owner may at any time add to the Party Wall in depth or thickness, but any other addition to said Party Wall in length, height or otherwise must be consented to by the owners on both sides of the Party Wall.In no event shall any extension of the Party Wall, interfere with, or impair the use of the Party Wall, nor shall any such addition interfere with, or impair the use of the Party Wall use or enjoyment of the townhouse belonging to the adjoining owner. 4. If the Party Wall is at any time extended, the cost of such extension shall be paid by the owner making such extension. 5. In the event the Party Wall shall be damaged or destroyed by fire or other casualty, the owners on each side of the Party Wall agree to reconstruct the Party Wall as provided herein with respect to use, location and construction; each owner agrees to apply the funds received from any insurance carrier, or third party who may be responsible for the damage to the Party Wall, toward the reconstruction of the Party Wall. 6. In the event of the making of any repairs to or rebuilding of said Party Wall or any addition or change thereto, the owner so doing shall make such repairs or rebuild or addtoor extend saidPartyWallin such away as toleave the owner on the other sideofthePartyWallasnearlyasisreasonablypossibleunderthecircumstances, in the same condition with respect to said Party Wall as before and shall use good material throughout and do such work in a good, substantial and workmanlike manner. Such owner so repairing or rebuilding or extending shall do all work in connection therewith, as far as is reasonably possible from his own side of the division line and shall do all work in conformance with the requirements of the Building Laws of the State and City of New York and the rules, regulations and ordinances of any governmental authority having jurisdiction thereof. If it shall become necessary to repair or rebuild the Party Wall or any portion of the Party Wall as constructed, the cost of such repairing and/or such rebuilding, as to such portions of the Party Wall used by both owners, shall be borne equally by both owners. 8. If and when the Party Wall is rebuilt it shall stand upon the same place and be of the same or similar materials and of the same proportions as the Party Wall described above. 9. No director,member,officer or employee of the Declarants shall be personally liable under or by reason of this Declaration of Restrictions, nor shall any director, breachofthisDeclarationofRestrictions.

Bldgs.11 & 12 10.Nothing herein contained shall obligate or make responsible or liable in any way in connection with suchPartyWall any owner of either of saidparcels of land except for the owner's actsof omission and commission while owner. This Declaration of Restrictions shall remain in effect so long as one of the townhouses shallremainstanding.In the eventboth townhouses are demolished or destroyed, then, and in such event, this Declaration of Restrictions shall automatically terminate,butnothing contained in thisDeclaration of Restrictions shall prevent the owners from negotiating and entering into a Party Wall DeclarationofRestrictions.
